corrections.cause: The auditor unconditionally required a non-empty optimization trajectory although Static S0 preregistered zero optimization updates.
corrections.resolution: Reconstructed each S0 single-point train trajectory from its immutable checkpoint history after verifying zero planned/completed updates, zero calls/tokens/commits, no second-stage events, no responsibility state, and identical initial/final team hash.

corrections.cause: The generic checkpoint restore recomputed optimizer responsibility caches that are not consumed by read-only final-state evaluation and rejected otherwise valid frozen final prompt states.
corrections.resolution: Loaded exactly five checkpoint prompts, validated the mutable-prompt contract, and required the reconstructed team hash to match the frozen final-state hash before every validation/test evaluation. No optimizer cache was used by prediction.
